oews_state.name: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics (state)
oews_state.methodology: State cross-industry employment, annual wage percentile, and location-quotient estimates (https://www.bls.gov/oes/special-requests/oesm25st.zip). Covers the 50 states plus the District of Columbia and Puerto Rico. Wages reported by BLS as unavailable ("*"), employment reported as unavailable ("**"), and annual wages at or above $239,200 (BLS top-code "#") are all null — treated as insufficient data, never invented. Wages are rounded to whole dollars; location quotients (state employment concentration vs. the national average, 1.0 = national share) are rounded to 2 decimals.

bea_rpp.name: U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis, Regional Price Parities
bea_rpp.methodology: All-items Regional Price Parity (RPP), 2024, U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis (public domain). RPP expresses local price levels as a percent of the national level (US = 100). The UI derives purchasing-power-adjusted ("national") dollars as national_dollars = local_wage / (rpp / 100) — a computed division, labeled as such. Areas without a published RPP (notably BLS nonmetropolitan areas and metropolitan divisions, which BEA does not cover, and Puerto Rico) carry rpp: null — never approximated from neighbors.
